channel.description: Latest articles from Titel Media GmbH (highsnobiety.com)

item.title: How Ralph Lauren Made the Ultimate Japanese Denim Levi’s
item.description: Ralph Lauren Double RL & BEAMS two-piece drop is a replica of Levi’s clothing from the 1940s. And proudly so.

item.title: Levi's Delicious Denim Jordan Sneakers Are Pure Jean-ius
item.description: Levi's cooks up three Air Jordan 3 sneakers made with its famous denim. Here's everything on its jean-ius collaboration.

item.title: Nike’s Techiest Air Max Sneaker Is Now Also Its Suavest Stepper
item.description: Nike's Air Max DN8 Leather arrives as a stylish suede-like version of the high-tech sneaker.

item.title: Every Chunky Shoe Owes a Debt to This HOKA
item.description: The Bondi 7 is back. And nothing has changed about this legendary chunky shoe, but a lot has changed about how it's being marketed.

item.title: New Balance’s GORE-TEX Dad Shoe Is Lowkey Rugged, Highkey Fresh
item.description: New Balance's 1906 GORE-TEX takes the classic dad shoe model to rugged levels, complete with a clean "Shipyard" colorway.

item.title: An Arte-ful Kind of Laceless Leather adidas Sneaker
item.description: Arte Antwerp releases its adidas Trivela sneaker collaboration, which is a stylish leather zip-up model offered in three colorways.

item.title: This Clothing Line Is Basically Just Luxury 'Twin Peaks' Merch
item.description: UNDERCOVER’s second ode to David Lynch plays out in a Twin Peaks-themed capsule collection. It's pretty straightforward stuff, but that's why it's genius.

item.title: Vans’ Citrus-Flavored Trail Sneaker Is a Thirst-Quenching Treat
item.description: Vans' Crosspath trail sneaker appears in a fruity "Marmalade Orange" colorway, resulting in the sweetest & tangiest version yet.

item.title: A Very LA Evening with adidas Originals & Highsnobiety
item.description: Last week at Cafe Triste in Los Angeles, familiar faces and industry socialites were seated for an intimate dinner with adidas Originals and Highsnobiety to celebrate the new adistar XLG.

item.title: Vans’ New Skate Shoe Is so Chic, It Flips the Checkerboard
item.description: Vans' luxury-level Authentic sneaker is a classic checkerboard shredder made to be super chic.
